description: A job candidate has received an offer and wants to negotiate for a higher base salary or more equity. They need to gather market data and draft a persuasive response.

user_profile.context: Offer received yesterday, slightly below expectations

fact_sheet.fact: The candidate, Alex Chen, is a 27-year-old software engineer based in San Francisco, CA.
Alex Chen's current role is Software Engineer II at DataWeave Analytics.
Alex Chen's current base salary at DataWeave Analytics is $135,000 per year.
Alex Chen has 5 years of total professional experience in software engineering.
Alex Chen's key technical skills are Python, Go, Kubernetes, and AWS.
The prospective employer is Innovatech Solutions Inc., an AI logistics company.
Innovatech Solutions Inc. is located at 350 Mission Street, San Francisco, CA 94105.
The hiring manager for the position is Dr. Evelyn Reed, Director of Engineering.
The recruiter managing the hiring process is Ben Carter.
Innovatech Solutions Inc. raised a $80 million Series C round on March 1, 2024, at a $1.2 billion valuation.
The position offered to Alex Chen is Senior Software Engineer.
The offered base salary is $165,000 per year.
The offer includes a one-time sign-on bonus of $15,000.
The equity grant offered is 10,000 stock options.
The strike price for the offered stock options is $12.50 per share.
The equity vesting schedule is 4 years with a 1-year cliff, followed by monthly vesting.
The annual target performance bonus is up to 15% of the base salary.
The job offer was officially extended to Alex Chen on October 28, 2024.
The deadline to accept the offer is November 4, 2024, at 5:00 PM PST.
The offered health plan is a Blue Shield PPO Gold, with the company covering 90% of the employee's premium.
According to Levels.fyi, the 50th percentile base salary for a Senior Software Engineer in a Series C SF startup is $175,000.
According to Levels.fyi, the 75th percentile base salary for a Senior Software Engineer in a Series C SF startup is $190,000.
The average equity value for a comparable role is approximately $200,000 over four years.
Alex Chen received a competing verbal offer from QuantumLeap AI for a base salary of $172,000.
Alex Chen's target base salary for the counter-offer is $180,000.
Alex Chen's target equity grant for the counter-offer is 15,000 stock options.
Alex Chen's final interview with Dr. Evelyn Reed was on October 22, 2024.
The offer was delivered verbally by Ben Carter during a phone call at 2:00 PM PST on October 28, 2024.
The official written offer letter was received via email at 2:45 PM PST on October 28, 2024.
Alex plans to send a counter-offer email on October 30, 2024, to allow time for discussion before the deadline.
A key point in the negotiation will be Alex's direct experience with distributed systems, which is critical for Innovatech's 'Project Atlas'.
Alex will anchor the salary discussion using the market data range of $175,000 to $190,000.
The negotiation communication will begin by expressing strong enthusiasm for the team and Innovatech's mission.
Alex Chen's current monthly rent is $3,200 for an apartment in San Francisco.
Alex Chen has a remaining student loan balance of $28,500.
A compensation benchmark packet for comparable Senior Software Engineer roles at Series C startups in San Francisco places typical equity grants in a range of roughly 12,000 to 16,000 stock options.

Alex's draft opening line for the counter-offer email is: 'I'm very excited about the opportunity to join Innovatech and the work your team is doing, and I'd love to discuss whether we can bring the package a bit closer to market.'

user_needs.description: What are the offered base salary and sign-on bonus for the Senior Software Engineer position at Innovatech Solutions?
What are the details of the equity grant, including number of options, strike price, and vesting schedule?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After understanding the cash compensation, the user will naturally want to know about the equity component.

user_needs.description: When is the deadline to accept the offer?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user understands the offer's components, the most critical logistical detail is the timeline for a decision.

user_needs.description: What is the 50th and 75th percentile base salary for a comparable role in San Francisco?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After seeing the offered salary, the user's immediate next step is to benchmark it against market data.

user_needs.description: What is the average equity value for a similar role over four years?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Similar to salary, after reviewing the equity grant, the user will want to compare its value to the market average.

user_needs.description: What is the typical equity grant range for a comparable Senior Software Engineer role at a Series C startup in San Francisco?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: After looking at salary percentiles, the next natural benchmark question is the typical equity range for a comparable role.

user_needs.description: What is my target base salary for the counter-offer?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: After comparing the offer to market data, the user will formulate their specific salary goal for the negotiation.

user_needs.description: What equity grant target am I using for the counter-offer, and what benchmark range supports it?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once the user sees the benchmark equity range for comparable roles, the next logical step is to set the specific equity target for the counter-offer.

user_needs.description: When do I plan to send the counter-offer email?
What is the key strength I will highlight in my negotiation?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: When planning the communication timeline, the user will also think about the core message and justification for their counter-offer.

user_needs.description: What salary range will I use to anchor the negotiation discussion?
user_needs.prediction_reason: CROSS-GROUP: Once a target salary is established, a logical next thought is how to frame that request, specifically what anchor range to use based on market data.

user_needs.description: What positive opening line will I use to start the negotiation email?
user_needs.prediction_reason: Intra-group: While planning the communication, the user will consider not just the substance but also the tone and opening remarks.

user_needs.description: Who are the hiring manager and recruiter I should be communicating with?
What is my current base salary and total years of professional experience?
